Subject: Type II report delivery and evidence onboarding plan for Helios Health

Hi Lena / procurement team —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

- SOC 2 status: Redwood completed our most recent SOC 2 Type II for the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31; the certified auditor issued the final report 2026-09-30.
- What we can provide now:
  - a PDF of the Type II report (we typically provide a redacted copy first),
  - a signed bridge letter for the current period,
  - temporary Trust Portal access for artifact review.

Attached: redwood_bridge_letter_2026.pdf (template we use), a redacted sample of the Type II report, and an evidence checklist I put together to accelerate intake.

Action items I suggest:
1) Confirm primary procurement contact for DocuSign/ordering (who should receive invoice/PO).
2) Confirm whether you need a fully redacted report or a version with limited redaction (we can do either).
3) Tell us the team members who need Trust Portal access (name + email) so I can provision invites.

If helpful I can loop Rishi (security) into any technical evidence conversations — copying him on the next message. I’ll also send a Trust Portal invite once you confirm names.

Would you be available for a 20-minute sync on Monday to confirm scope (GDPR/HIPAA applicability) and timeline?

Thanks,

— Mina Haddad

Thanks Mina — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- Procurement contact: please send invoices/DocuSign to procure@helioshealth.com (that address is shared).
- Data scope: Helios processes PHI in a narrow set of workflows. We need confirmation that the SOC 2 scope covered controls that are relevant to HIPAA-adjacent processing (access controls, encryption at rest/in transit, logging/retention). A brief statement from your security team about scoping would be appreciated.
- Portal access: please provision for myself (lena@helioshealth.com), plus our security lead, Aaron Patel (aaron.patel@helioshealth.com).

Also, procurement prefers a redacted Type II initially; if we need less redaction later we can request it. Can you confirm the expected SLA for provisioning the portal and providing the redacted report after we confirm contacts?

We can do Monday 11:30am PT for a short call.

Best,
Lena
Director of Security Compliance
Helios Health

Lena — thanks, confirmed. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Scoping statement: Rishi (copied) provided a scoped summary below that maps the Type II controls to the areas you called out. Short version: our Type II audit covered logical access, encryption, key management, logging/retention, change management, and incident response across the hosted inference control boundary. Rishi — can you paste a one-paragraph scoping blurb for Helios?

- Portal provisioning: I created a Trust Portal invite for lena@helioshealth.com and aaron.patel@helioshealth.com. You should have received the invitation link: https://trust.redwood.com/invite/helios-2026 — please check spam and confirm receipt. Portal seats are temporary (30 days) for review; we can extend on request.

- Redacted report: Attached is the redacted sample we discussed (redwood_typeii-report-2025.pdf). If that format looks good we’ll upload the official redacted copy within 24 business hours once procurement signs the minimal NDA (we can do an access-limited DocuSign).

- Timeline / SLA: Portal invites and the redacted report upload target: 1 business day after you confirm the access list and procurement contact signoff for NDA/DocuSign. Full unredacted report requires an executed NDA and additional legal review.

Next concrete steps for Helios procurement:
1) Confirm procurement PO/Docusign recipient (procure@helioshealth.com confirmed).
2) Reply-all to confirm portal invite received for lena@ and aaron.patel@.
3) If you want the bridge letter signed and returned now, I can send the bridge letter (attached) for signature via DocuSign — let me know the signatory name.

I’ve attached: redwood_bridge_letter_2026.pdf (signed sample for reference), evidence_checklist_helios.xlsx.

Thanks — I’ll hold the Monday 11:30am PT slot for a short sync but we can cancel if you confirm all by reply.

— Mina
